jobs.name: Bake planner layers here
jobs.reason: Needs GEOS and Java 21+. Install them, then check again.

jobs.name: Publish to prod
jobs.reason: Needs an R2 key. Ask the owner for the key, then put it in tools/obc.local.

jobs.name: Fetch sources that need an account
jobs.reason: Optional: 5 of 6 credentials are not set. Credentials names the sources of each.

credentials.name: OBC_REFERENCE_AU_INPUT and OBC_REFERENCE_AU_DATUM
uses: Terrain in Australia: ELVIS DEM 1–5 m, per order
credentials.hint: Order the area, then give the absolute path of the unpacked delivery and its vertical datum, such as AHD.

credentials.name: OBC_REFERENCE_DK_TOKEN
credentials.hint: Make a free account (Opret bruger), then copy a new token from Administrer token til webservices og API'er.

credentials.name: OBC_REFERENCE_FI_TOKEN
credentials.hint: Make a free NLS account, then create a key for the open data interfaces under API keys and copy it.

credentials.name: OBC_REFERENCE_SE_USER and OBC_REFERENCE_SE_PASSWORD
credentials.hint: Apply for Markhöjdmodell Nedladdning, grid 1+ with Basic authentication, then copy the consumer user name and password.

credentials.name: ~/.cdsapirc
uses: Climate layer: rain, temperature and wind of ten years
credentials.hint: Make a free account, accept the ERA5-Land licence on the dataset page, then copy the personal access token of your profile.

credentials.name: ~/.config/openbikecomputer/cdse-s3.env
uses: Snow layer in Europe: Sentinel-2 snow phenology at 20 m
Quarterly satellite colour for the TrailView colour and material
credentials.hint: Sign in with a free Copernicus Data Space account, add a credential, then copy its access key and secret key.

credentials.name: OBC_VPS_SSH
credentials.needed_for: deploy the follower on the VPS of prod
credentials.hint: The SSH host or alias of the VPS. It logs in as root with the SSH key of this machine, without a prompt.

credentials.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
credentials.needed_for: deploy the tiles Worker of prod
credentials.hint: Create a token with the template "Edit Cloudflare Workers". Copy it, and the ID of the account.
